facts.fact: Morocco's Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform announced the launch of a new version of the national Idarati portal, centred on Idarati e-Services as a unified access point to administrations' digital services.

facts.fact: Morocco's road-safety agency NARSA presented the E-ROKHSATI platform on 24 November 2026, which lets users renew driving licences and obtain duplicates fully online, with identity checked through Mon Identite Numerique and a QR-coded provisional receipt, without visiting Al Barid Bank or Barid Cash agencies (transport minister Abdessamad Kayouh).
